authorizing_request: Show the MMK quantity jump, exclude such outliers and plot month-to-month change distribution.
threshold_rationale: Previously documented extreme-growth flag, selected for a transparent first data-quality exclusion after the user's request, not by regression p-values.
monthly_rule: Closing calendar month minus opening calendar month = 1, and actual interval length between 20 and 40 days inclusive.
longer_intervals: Preserved separately; not labeled monthly and not annualized or divided into artificial months.
population: Current macro-complete H1 estimation sample, already excluding identified index funds; not every raw portfolio position.
scope: Separate cleaned data version and descriptive histograms; no overwrite of completed regressions or source portfolios.
